summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of DialectStudio (AI Content Creator Hub). Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass covering /api/content (all + category + dialect filters), /api/dialects (7 items), /api/generate for all 3 categories using Gemini via Emergent LLM key, /api/contact (success + email validation), and error handling. Frontend: Home renders hero, ad-banner-leaderboard, all three category cards, and featured grid; language switcher toggles EN/AR/KU and correctly flips document dir between ltr/rtl (AR default is rtl). Library page loads 7 tiktok-scripts cards with dialect filter pills, in-feed ad banner appears after 6th card, sidebar generator + rectangle ad visible on desktop, copy button works. Generator dialog opens from library/sidebar, accepts category/dialect/topic/vibe, generates 500+ char Arabic content, and shows gen-copy-btn. Contact form submits and shows contact-success. Mobile menu toggle works and reveals nav links.
critical_code_review_comments: Review request referenced testids `hero`, `ad-leaderboard`, `category-{id}`, `featured-grid` but code actually uses `hero-browse-btn`, `ad-banner-leaderboard`, `category-card-{id}`, and no `featured-grid` wrapper testid. Consider adding a `hero` wrapper testid and `featured-grid` testid for easier automated targeting; or update the review spec. Functionally everything works.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI `@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown')` — consider migrating to lifespan handlers.
CORS is `*` from env default — acceptable for preview but should be tightened for production.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 18 items from seed_data.SEED_CONTENT on startup automatically; no additional seed created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py (pytest, 11 tests, ~19s including 3 real Gemini calls). Actual data-testids differ slightly from review request naming: use `hero-browse-btn`, `hero-generate-btn`, `ad-banner-leaderboard`, `category-card-{id}`, `library-generate-btn`, `sidebar-generate-btn`. Contact form's `contact-topic` and `contact-dialect` are Radix Select buttons — click then click a `[role=option]`. Generator produces streamed text into `[data-testid=gen-result]`; allow up to 30s. RTL is default; language switcher `lang-en/lang-ar/lang-ku` toggles dir attribute on <html>.
